en: Which shape is round, with no corners?
A circle is round all the way and has no corners.
A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.
Which shape has 4 sides that are all the same?
A square has 4 equal sides and 4 corners.
A ball is round, so it can roll.
What shape is a slice of pizza?
A slice of pizza is pointed at one end, like a triangle.
A door has 4 sides: two long and two short. That is a rectangle.
A coin is round and flat, like a circle.
Which shape has 4 sides, two long and two short?
A rectangle has two long sides and two short sides.
What shape is a star on a Christmas tree?
A star has points sticking out all around.
What shape is the full moon?
The full moon looks round, like a circle.
What shape do we draw to show love?
We draw a heart shape to show love.
How many corners does a triangle have?
A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.
How many corners does a circle have?
A circle is round all the way, so it has no corners.
What shape is a window pane, with 4 equal sides?
Four equal sides make a square.
An egg is round but longer one way: an oval.

example.q_en: Which shape is round, with no corners?
example.why_en: A circle is round all the way and has no corners.

en.title: Shape names
en.teach: Count the sides and look at the corners. A triangle has 3 sides, a square has 4 equal sides, a circle is round.
